quote: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction, including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident, and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of any other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: If the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency is moving in the same direction of travel as the driver, not drive abreast of or overtake the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency. As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

activation.condition: approaching a qualifying flashing-light emergency or regulatory vehicle moving in the same direction, unless otherwise directed by an officer

obligation.description: do not drive abreast of or overtake the qualifying vehicle in the selected same-direction movement branch

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: Original officer direction may change the response; none is inferred from a synthetic request.

timing.description: upon approach during same-direction movement; no invented spatial or temporal cutoff

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency making use of qualifying flashing lights
judgment_calls_needed.note: Verify authorization, qualifying equipment and original lamp pixels independently of a blueprint or request.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: moving in the same direction of travel as the driver
judgment_calls_needed.note: Compare original actor headings, body trajectories and road lanes; the engineering heading check is not a legal cutoff.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: not drive abreast of or overtake
judgment_calls_needed.note: Keep original longitudinal body overlap and order crossings distinct; no statutory numeric overlap cutoff is supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
judgment_calls_needed.note: Verify officer identity, recipient, direction content and timing from original sources.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: preparing to move means any visible indication including movement or driver hand signals
judgment_calls_needed.note: The current selected moving branch does not prove a preparing-to-move alternative; retain a separate coverage gap.
